affected_component: adoption.intake.tool_drafter fixture-builder authoring protocol and deterministic source conformance
invariant: A task fixture builder must consume scenario-specific values from the normalized FixtureBlueprintV1 parameters object. Human labels, scenario prose, blueprint ids, and invented top-level fields cannot substitute for binding the published parameters protocol; a mismatch must stop during contract authoring before fixture generation, Agent execution, or repair.
